image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a used baseball. The ball features a white leather cover that is heavily scuffed and stained with dirt/grass marks. It has the characteristic red raised stitching in a figure-eight pattern. There are visible manufacturer markings: a red 'Rawlings' logo and blue ink stamps (likely league approval signatures). The lighting is soft, highlighting the texture of the leather and the wear on the surface.
